comparison.objective: Install a booster-seat tray at its second ratchet notch; candidate sets a gripper to a target opening angle and locks it.
comparison.physical_skill: Align a wide tray on two rails and advance two sprung catches into matching notches versus coaxial driver/wrench countertorque on one adjustable stop.
comparison.success_condition: Both catches locked at notch two, tray released and still for one second; wrong notches earn partial credit and movement or falls fail.
comparison.reason: Although both choose and retain a setting, dual-rail insertion with paired ratchet catches tests a different physical ability from threaded setting preservation.
